address: No. 2-4, Section 2, Jiefang Road, Jinniu, Chengdu, China Mainland
bio: Famous for its flat noodle soup, this eatery inevitably attracts long queues. Diners can see four chefs pulling a piece of dough to make the signature noodles – thin, soft, but with a lovely chew. The choice of toppings is relatively concise, but spicy and mild versions are available. Try the spicy beef with a hint of sweetness, or for a milder option, order the stewed free-range chicken loaded with shiitake aromas....
